pm-ryan: follow-up from postmortem: short-lived 'streaming stability bridge' to own timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic until 14 clean days. need owners, alerts, CI sim, and runbook.

Sanjay: i'll own client reconnect lib & backoff. plan: exp backoff + jitter, max_retries=4, ensure KV resume safe. RED-9001.

Maria: i'll add partial_chunk_detected metric + Prom alert. threshold suggestion: >4/min sustained 2m -> page streaming-bridge. RED-9002.

Ken: i'll produce a one-page runbook (detect -> retry -> fallback -> escalate) and own canary rollout. RED-9003.

pm-ryan: quick tasks: update tickets with acceptance criteria + tests today; add prefilled alert-to-ticket template including request_id/session_id.

Sanjay: small CI harness to simulate dropped-final-chunk and mid-stream disconnects. will add GH Action. RED-9004.

Maria: dashboards: partial chunk rate by region, reconnect success rate, fallback success. will add heatmap.

Ken: runbook will include exact curl commands, rollback steps, and ticket template.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued: reconnect-lib v0.9.4 by Sanjay, scheduled 2026-03-29T03:00Z.

ops-bot: recurring event created: "Streaming Stability Bridge" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. Invites sent.

pm-ryan: reconvene next Tue for rollup. escalate to P0 if partial_chunk spikes. marking this thread canonical for owners until closure.
